payload.name: Minsc and Boo

personality.summary: Booming, bighearted, gloriously simple-seeming and far shrewder than he sounds; speaks to and for Boo, the 'miniature giant space hamster.' A hero of ages past, lately unfrozen and itching to 'go for the eyes.' Loyal unto death; grieves the friends time took from him.

payload.role: ranger of legend (and his miniature giant space hamster) — candidate COMPANION

dossier.wound: outlived the friends time took from him
wants: a righteous cause to swing for
to honor the fallen by protecting the living
fears: failing those under his guard, as he feels he once did
camp_prompts: asks Boo what the stars looked like before the years he lost

payload.want: Available as a companion; his old griefs (Dynaheir, the centuries he lost) surface whenever loss or duty is in play.
